 * |------------------|--------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|----------|--------------|

 * | buffer/sum/idx   | Fresh start on enable| Not exposed externally      | Clear on enable=FALSE       | N/A      | VAR statics  |
 * 
 * CONTRACT_RULES []
 *)
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    enable    : BOOL;
    rawValue  : REAL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    filteredValue : REAL;
    windowFull    : BOOL;
    sampleCount   : INT;
END_VAR
VAR
    buffer     : ARRAY[0..7] OF REAL := (0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0);
    writeIndex : INT := 0;
    sum        : REAL := 0.0;
END_VAR
